stories.headline: Apple just launched a $2,000 foldable iPhone
stories.blurb: The iPhone Duo marks Apple's first foldable phone, priced at $1,999. Announced at the company's September event alongside AI features and other devices, it enters a market Samsung and others have occupied for years.
stories.why_it_matters: Apple's finally playing catch-up in foldables — at flagship pricing
stories.original_headline: Apple Unveils the iPhone Duo, a Foldable Phone That Costs $1,999

stories.headline: AWS is giving 132 universities free access to its AI coding assistant
stories.blurb: Students at 132 schools across 18 countries get a full year of Kiro free — Amazon's AI pair programmer that writes, debugs, and explains code inside VS Code and JetBrains. AWS wants graduates who've already logged hours with an agent before their first job.
stories.why_it_matters: Free tier wars are moving upstream to capture students before they pick a default tool.
stories.original_headline: Millions of students can now get access to a free year of Kiro from AWS

stories.headline: Google's AI can now pinpoint methane leaks from orbit
stories.blurb: Google and NASA's Jet Propulsion Lab built a deep learning model that processes satellite imagery from EMIT to detect and measure methane emissions anywhere on Earth. The tool can spot leaks from oil wells, landfills, and agriculture that ground sensors miss—turning orbital data into a global emissions map.
stories.why_it_matters: Methane traps 80x more heat than CO2 short-term, and most leaks go undetected without satellites.
stories.original_headline: A new deep learning model maps global methane emissions from space.

stories.headline: DeepSeek just made AI 100x cheaper with new model priced at pennies
stories.blurb: DeepSeek released a new AI model charging a fraction of a cent per million tokens—far below what OpenAI, Anthropic, and other rivals charge. The pricing puts pressure on competitors who've been racing to cut costs while maintaining performance.
stories.why_it_matters: AI inference just became cheap enough to run at scale in consumer apps without burning cash
stories.original_headline: DeepSeek’s New Low-Cost Model Deals a Fresh Blow to OpenAI, Z.ai

try_this_prompt.prompt: I'm reviewing a candidate who looks good on paper but something feels off. I'll describe what I noticed in the interview and their background.
